tabs.content:
// Create materialized view for the Gold Layer:
// Sales, Total Orders and Total Quantity by OrderDate, Hour, ProductCategory and ProductName
.create async materialized-view with (folder = "Gold", backfill=true) GoldRapidOrders on table 
SilverRapidOrders
{
    SilverRapidOrders
    | summarize TotalSales = sum(TotalSalesAmount), 
    TotalQuantity = sum(OrderQuantity), NumberOfOrders = count() 
    by OrderDate, OrderHour = substring(OrderTime, 0, 2), 
    ProductCategory, ProductName 
}

GoldRapidOrders
| order by OrderDate desc, OrderHour desc
| take 20
tabs.title: Materialized Views
